    Relative almost-split meshes under primitive deletion #

    This file realizes every Hoshino mesh in the literal primitive-quotient subcategory, proves both maps are minimal almost split, and derives endpoint and source uniqueness. These are the mesh-theoretic inputs for the global gaining-pair construction.

    source

    CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (PrimitiveQuotientSubcategory e)

    The Hoshino relative mesh bundled in the literal primitive-quotient subcategory. Its underlying ambient short complex is fgShortComplex.

      Function.Injective (sourceLabel H he)

      Distinct primitive new meshes have distinct quotient sources. This is the sourcewise counterpart of endpoint extensionality and follows from uniqueness of minimal left almost-split maps in mod(A/AeA).
